animals.name: Simba
animals.imageAlt: Illustration of Simba, a friendly cross-breed dog
animals.summary: A two-year-old male cross-breed dog, friendly and great with children. Fully vaccinated and sterilised.
animals.details: Simba loves fetch, long walks and being around kids. He walks well on a lead and does best in a home with a garden.

animals.name: Miso
animals.imageAlt: Illustration of Miso, a playful tabby cat
animals.summary: A one-year-old female tabby cat, playful and litter-trained. Fully vaccinated and sterilised.
animals.details: Miso is curious and affectionate, and gets along with other cats. She would suit a home with plenty of climbing space and toys.

animals.name: Rocky
animals.imageAlt: Illustration of Rocky, a calm terrier mix
animals.summary: A five-year-old male terrier mix, calm and well-suited to an apartment. Fully vaccinated and sterilised.
animals.details: Rocky is a gentle senior-in-the-making who enjoys short walks and quiet evenings. He is house-trained and fine alone for a few hours.

animals.name: Luna
animals.summary: A three-year-old female cat, shy at first but very loving once settled. Fully vaccinated and sterilised.
animals.details: Luna needs a patient family and a quiet space to settle in. Once she trusts you she is a champion lap cat.

animals.name: Max
animals.summary: A one-year-old male dog full of energy, looking for an active home with a garden. Fully vaccinated and sterilised.
animals.details: Max is smart, playful and still learning his manners. He would thrive with training, daily exercise and a secure garden.

animals.name: Daisy
animals.summary: A two-year-old female rabbit, gentle and used to being handled. Sterilised and health-checked.
animals.details: Daisy enjoys fresh greens and a roomy run. She is calm with respectful children and would love a bonded companion.

animals.name: Pepper
animals.summary: A four-year-old male cat with a big personality. An adoption is currently pending. Fully vaccinated and sterilised.
animals.details: Pepper has an application pending. If it falls through we will update this page, so check back soon or enquire to join the waiting list.
